pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal regions with rounded vertices and soft pixel gradients at the boundaries. The patches exhibit a non-uniform spatial distribution with varying area across the neck-to-flank transition.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light-toned interstitial pathways forming tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness of the pathways fluctuates significantly between patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged silhouette visible along the upper neck boundary, though individual hair fibers are blurred into a continuous edge.
